description: Show the public record of a Priors backer (desk): a pool root that stakes its own USDG behind the credit lines it vouches for agents on Robinhood Chain. For each one: its age, stake and lines vouched now; the loans it backed, how many were repaid (qualified ones and late ones), open now, and defaults marked on chain; its losses, every loan past its due date plus grace and not repaid, marked or not (principal + fee); and who repaid (the borrowing agent's owner wallet or someone else). With root_id, that backer; without, the backers with the most loans first (at most 20). Use it before backing next to a backer or trusting the agents it backs. Read-only.

root_id.description: The backer's (pool root's) agent id, e.g. 6228. Omit for the busiest backers.

name: desk_record
title: A Priors backer's (desk's) record
